claim_ceiling: typed externally signed TaskFlow admission and concrete local durable single-use consumption source only; no trusted approval UI, installed effect adapter, native retained-target qualification, network egress, operator recovery decision, protected anti-rollback, hardware or release authority

arguments.url: exact credential-free URL under the same canonical origin

json_profile.objects: closed field sets at every boundary; duplicate members refused
json_profile.numbers: bounded integers only; bool, floats, NaN and Infinity refused
json_profile.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, separators comma/colon, ensure_ascii=false, no unpaired surrogate
json_profile.origin: exact lowercase credential-free HTTPS origin including distinct synthetic HTTPS for trusted apps; no custom scheme/path/query/fragment/default443port
json_profile.signature: canonical padded base64 encoding of exactly64 Ed25519 bytes

signing.key_encoding: canonical44-byte DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo with Ed25519 OID and32-byte public key
signing.key_pin: SHA-256 of complete DER bytes from externally approved provisioning
signing.verification: fixed /usr/bin/openssl pkeyutl -verify -rawin -pubin -keyform DER with three sealed inherited memfd snapshots via /proc/self/fd and sanitized environment
signing.revocation: trusted caller may monotonically revoke key IDs or permit IDs; this source API has no revocation removal

transitions.proposed_to_approved: exact current proposal match plus actual external offline signature and current root/permit validity
transitions.approved_to_dispatched: exact native binding and current root/permit/control/deadline plus concrete durable consumption; irreversible single-use state before adapter entry
transitions.dispatched_to_terminal: typed known completion before the original deadline with current authority
transitions.dispatched_to_indeterminate: unknown or untyped completion, exception, cancellation, handoff, lost authority or late result; no replay
transitions.predispatch_cancel_or_handoff: close current action and task; no adapter invocation
transitions.new_task_after_revisions_change: fresh independently authorized task policy, identifiers and permit required; no automatic reference translation

durable_consumption.root: externally provisioned service-owned0700 directory; nofollow retained ancestor chain and exclusive validated0600 one-link lease; creatorPID checked before locking
durable_consumption.task_reservation: every accepted taskID is durably O_EXCL reserved with exact policy digest before proposals or approval; task-<SHA256(task_id)>.reserved is immutable and never deleted
durable_consumption.commit: three O_EXCL0600 one-link immutable files, retained descriptors, complete writes, file fsync, directory fsync, exact bytes/inode/name/root/ancestor readback before adapter dispatch
durable_consumption.failure: partial writes, sync failure, path drift or custody ambiguity poison the instance; historical partial or corrupt sets refuse open; evidence never deleted
durable_consumption.replay: reservation and consumption survive coordinator/service restart; nonce substitution cannot reuse original action; all previously reserved task IDs require a separate recovery protocol before resume, including predispatch cancellation/handoff/deadline closure
durable_consumption.capacity: fail closed; no pruning or shortened authoritative history
durable_consumption.anti_rollback: not provided; whole-directory rollback requires an independently protected anchor

remaining_integration: authenticated provisioning and current revocation delivery
trusted native approval UI issuing externally signed permits
installed native effect adapter using retained current target and final ActionControl check
product receipt lifecycle and durable terminal outcome integration
exact installed-image evidence, independent review and protected promotion
